title: BMX280 Configuration
description: Configuration for a BMP280 or BME280 environmental sensor.

scl.description: The GPIO pin number of the SCL pin of the I2C bus.

sda.description: The GPIO pin number of the SDA pin of the I2C bus.

address.description: The I2C address of the sensor. If absent uses the default address. If set to 'alt' uses the alternate address. Otherwise, the address must be a valid I2C address.
